nutshell.headline: 9 new failures — all newly-added QuotaGroup scheduling tests (NXS-13489, gergely.gimesi) plus one Quota lock timing flake; no product regression
nutshell.causeText: The 8 QuotaGroup fails are all in brand-new scheduling test files added by gergely.gimesi under NXS-13489 (commits b3542e489333, 5825fa536595, 39b417d8302c, f6c7eff44b2d, 181dd637f7a0), red on their first nightly — including validation tests expecting HTTP 400 but getting 500 from dk-project-quota-group-rest (commit f6c7eff44b2d links these to known bugs NXS-13937/13938/13939) and a 'Scheduled time cannot be in the past!' test-data bug. No product service owning these endpoints was deployed in the window (only AlertTriggerRest, CrmRest, DemandApi, DetailsEditorRest), so this is test authorship, not a product regression or infra. The 1 Quota 'lock sold quota' fail is a separate cross-service lag (feasibility not ready after 30s) and looks flaky.
nutshell.investigation: Reading the messages, the 'QA 504 timeout' and several 'assert_fail' labels are really HTTP 500s (test expected 400) and assertion mismatches inside gergely.gimesi's new QuotaGroup scheduling tests (NXS-13489), not infra. Only the Quota sold-quota lock fail is timing (30s cross-service lag) and it sits outside the changed area.
bullets: 8/9 new fails are in gergely.gimesi's newly-added QuotaGroupScheduling* tests (NXS-13489)
Labels mislead: 'QA 504 timeout' is really an HTTP 500 (expected 400) from quota-group-rest; some 'assert_fail' are expected-red vs known bugs NXS-13937/13938/13939
1 Quota lock fail = separate cross-service lag (30s) flake, outside the changed area

detail.investigation: All 9 failures are new since the green prior build (#3.0.2708, 0 fails), and 8 of the 9 live in test files gergely.gimesi added in this same build under NXS-13489 (QuotaGroupSchedulingValidationTestSteps, QuotaGroupSchedulingExecutionTestSteps, QuotaGroupSchedulingWorkflowTestSteps) — so this is new coverage failing on its first nightly, not a fresh product regression. The cluster labels are misleading once you read the messages: 'Misaligned fieldwork dates...' is tagged QA 504 but is actually an HTTP 500 (test expected 400) from dk-project-quota-group-rest, and 'Saving traffic schedules without fieldwork dates...' likewise expected 400 but got a 500 'Body parameter 1 was null' — both are validation endpoints returning 500 instead of 400, and commit f6c7eff44b2d explicitly links these validation features to known product bugs NXS-13937/13938/13939 (expected-red). Three 'Scheduled START/STOP Traffic leaves a #audienceStatus audience unchanged' cases are genuine assertion mismatches (audience moved to STARTED/PAUSED instead of staying CLOSED/FIELDWORK_COMPLETE), one 'Fieldwork dates ... while a schedule that already ran is kept' fails with 'Scheduled time cannot be in the past!' (stale test-data date), and 'A new audience inherits the Apply to all traffic schedules...' is missing an expected schedule slot. Crucially, no QA deploy in the window touched the failing service — only AlertTriggerRest, CrmRest, DemandApi and DetailsEditorRest were deployed — so a backend regression on quota-group-rest is not supported by the change data. The remaining failure, Quota 'Locking and unlocking sold quota...', is unrelated to gimesi's changes and is a cross-service lag (QuotaDetails/FeasDataStore/DetailsEditor not ready after 30s) that reads as a flaky/timing issue.
bullets: 8 of 9 new fails are in gergely.gimesi's brand-new QuotaGroupScheduling* test files (NXS-13489), red on first nightly run

'Saving traffic schedules without fieldwork dates...' also expected 400, got 500 'Body parameter 1 was null'
Commit f6c7eff44b2d explicitly links these validation features to known product bugs NXS-13937/13938/13939 (expected-red)
3× 'Scheduled START/STOP Traffic leaves a #audienceStatus audience unchanged' — audience moved to STARTED/PAUSED instead of staying CLOSED/FIELDWORK_COMPLETE (new execution tests)
'Fieldwork dates ... while a schedule that already ran is kept' fails with 'Scheduled time cannot be in the past!' — stale test-data date
No QA deploy touched quota-group-rest (only AlertTriggerRest, CrmRest, DemandApi, DetailsEditorRest) — no product regression in the window
Separate: Quota 'lock sold quota' fails after 30s cross-service lag (QuotaDetails/FeasDataStore/DetailsEditor) — flaky, outside the changed area
